ConnectionStrings._comment: Set the DATABASE_URL environment variable (Neon postgres:// URI) or CONNECTIONSTRINGS__DEFAULTCONNECTION. Never commit real credentials.

Auth._comment: Set AUTH__APIKEY environment variable. Never commit a real key.

App._comment: Set APP__SHORTURLDOMAIN to the public base URL (e.g. https://urlshortener.onrender.com). Used to build short links and reject self-referral URLs.

Cors._comment: Override with CORS__ALLOWEDORIGINS__0 / __1 env vars if a separate frontend origin needs access.
